title: Very simple, very lightweight
text: Very simple, very lightweight. I guess I expected this to be a little prettier. It’s quite dull and lacks luster. It’s very lightweight. It looks like something you’d pick up at Worldmarket for about $10. The ridges prevent you from placing cheese on it since it’ll smush down into them. I’m having a hard time figuring out what it can be used for. You can turn it over if you want and use the flat side.
